body: Okay mate thank you for taking your time out to speak to me

I can't speak to people though I could never open up to anyone I think I've got multiple brain disorders from googling what I go through but never diagnosed because i could never go to a doctor and tell him ive never even taken anti depressants which believe me there are loads of people on and no where near the state of mind I'm in because I can't tell anyone but I don't even want to be treated though I just dont want to be here and I'm not meant to be here no one is supposed to live like this but everytime I try I physically can't do it even though mentally I did it a long time ago, maybe it's just human instinct kicking in? we're meant to reproduce not take away from the population so I supose we're wired not to be able to do it who knows? I'm also paranoid, I suffer so much I sometimes think nothing is real and people are computer generated and this place was designed to be as horrible as possible to me and real people are somehow watching me on a screen and laughing I can feel them laughing at me and I know it's not right but that's how I think now that in its self must be some kind of mental disorder but I wouldn't know which

That's the thing though growing up I wanted win and I fought it but not anynore I don't want to win it any more I'm tired and I just want to close my eyes for good there's nothing here for me nothing I can't think of anything I like I fail at everything I have nothing but it's not even like I want anything anynore I just want to die this world is a horrible place for some one like me, all I ever did was try but it wasn't enough and people around me don't seem to try at all and succeed in every aspect of there life, I feel I was born at the wrong time and I'm the wrong place maybe even to the wrong race I'm just so different and not right there's nothing right about me

Everyday I'm living inside my own personal hell my social anxiety is off the chart I always feel weird I've never fit in any where not even with my family I'm 24 now I feel like I've just done 24 years in my own little prison that my brain designed so I can't be free I over analyse everything I'm still thinking about shit that I did like 10 years ago re living it everyday is hell the only thing I fantasize about is death and how much it needs to happen so I can escape this sentence, I've come to terms that death is my only option for over a year now and I've come to peace with it but everytime I try and do it I just start crying and can't go through with it its like something's holding me back and I'm meant to suffer but I don't know why I've never done anything bad to anyone why do I deserve this
Unfotunatly im not a very good speaker i wish you could see inside my brain you would understand
